risks: Canonical input becomes1920B contiguous segments with whole-K row strides; same bytes does not imply same DMA time.
Metadata TU compaction emits16/64B fragments; actual store cost must be measured.
Each table lookup reads all32B and carries a dependent HBM offset roundtrip; no free cache assumption.
New projection consumer must apply token-group scales before interslice reduction and update checked raw scale extents; outside this tree.
Allocator padding/lifetimes and exact gather lowering must be reported, not inferred from tensor sums.

correctness_plan: Independent i64 quotient/remainder oracle for every group, not table-multiplier reuse.
Check every packed byte/nibble/row/group, every F32 scale bit and every relative offset after candidate first.
Group/row-distinguishable finite BF16 fixtures, zero/FTZ/ties/extreme rows, group maxima on edges; all512row bits matter.
True row permutation plus within-group permutation preserves group membership; separate group permutation remaps scales consistently.
Distinct poisoned output/scales/offset owners, repeat/reuse, immutable input/table/shifts after complete calls.
Full Record8 table includes nonzero lane canaries; onlylane0 may feed multiplier.
No production/accuracy inference from exact code oracle.
